title: Cryptocurrency | Polygon Matic | Crypto Lover
description:
Polygon (MATIC), a powerful cryptocurrency that's transforming Ethereum through advanced scaling solutions. This guide breaks down how Polygon enhances DeFi, blockchain technology, and the role of MATIC tokens. Perfect for crypto lovers looking to deepen their understanding of this innovative platform.

This video is not a promotional video or an endorsement of any cryptocurrency. It is simply an effort to provide a casual understanding of the subject for informational purposes only. Please do your own research and exercise caution when dealing with cryptocurrencies.

asr.full_text: Hi folks, First of all, thanks for clicking on this video, I don't want waste your valuable time. So let's start about Polygon Crypto Coin Polygon previously known as matic Network, is a platform that helps scale and develop infrastructure for Ethereum, making it more efficient and user friendly and the core of Polygon is its SDK, a toolkit that allows developer to build various types of application. Now let's see what is Polygon? So Polygon is a layer 2 scaling solution for Ethereum, meaning It helps Ethereum handle transaction more quickly and efficiently, And also by creating additional layers or chain that work alongside Ethereum . This include Optimistic Rollup Chains, ZK Rollup Chains and the stats allow all of which enhance ethereum's capabilities. Now let's jump how Polygon works. So Polygon turns the ethereum into a multi-chain system. Similarly to each other networks like Polkadot or Cosmos this system benefits from Ethereum security and eco system but adds new layer of functionality and speed. Now coming to the role of the Matic token is. Matic is Polygon's native token. It plays a crucial role in securing the network and enabling governance. Means, It helps make decision about the network's future and matic tokens are also used to pay transaction fees within the polygon ecosystem. And it also supports from major players Polygon is backed by well-known companies like, Binance and Coinbase, and its goal is to encourage widespread use of cryptocurrency by solving the scalability issues that may come in blockchain phases. Now let's look into the key features of Polygon. Polygon combines two key technologies – the plasma framework and proof-of-stake blockchain architecture. Plasma means proposed by Ethereum's co-founded value for scalable and autonomous smart contracts. This means, Developer can create applications that can grow without facing the usual issues of the traditional blockchains. So, Coming to the performance and scalability Polygon can handle upto 65,000 transactions per second on a single side chain with block confirmation happens in under 2s. Okay. This makes it an attractive platform for building decentalized financial application or DEFI , which can be accessed globally. Now, let us see the diverse applications tokens like bitcoin and more than 50 Dapps have been built on Polygon's ethereum sidechain. Now Matic Tokens. Here Matic tokens or ERC-20 tokens, mean on ethereum blockchain are used for payment service on Polygon and has a settlement currency within its ecosystem. So transaction fee on Polygon's sidechains are also paid in Matic tokens. Now coming to the history and team behind the Polygon. So Polygon was launched in October 2017. and co-founder iser Jayant Kani , Samdeep Naival and Anurj Arjun before launching their Network in 2019 the team contributed Significantly to the Ethereum ecosystem including developing the Plasma, MVP and wallet connector protocol. Now coming to the end the future of Polygon. So while Polygon currently supports only the Ethereum base chain. It plans to support additional Base chain based on community's suggestion and consumption and this world make Polygon and InterOpal layer to platform connecting different blockchain in decentralized manner so coming to the closing Polygon is a powerful tool that enhance ethereum network making is faster, more scalable with it is strong backing and innovative technology making its faster, more scalable , and is positioned to play a significant role in the future of decentralized finance and blockchain technology.
